steps.note: The cocoa and sweetener are made into a concentrate with lambda carrageenan, which keeps the cocoa suspended, and the concentrate is mixed into part of the milk.
The milk undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.
The concentrate is diluted and stirred for 15–30 minutes before it is packed.
